items.quote: Wenn Sie verhindert sind, sagen Sie bitte mindestens zwei Werktage vorher ab, damit wir den Termin anderweitig vergeben können.
items.computation: Appointment day is Monday, 14.12.2026. The practice's address (35576 Wetzlar) places it in Hesse, so Hessian definitions/holidays are used. 'Werktag' in common usage covers Monday through Saturday, excluding Sundays and public holidays. Counting back from the appointment day (not counting the appointment day itself): the preceding day, Sunday 13.12.2026, is not a Werktag and is skipped; Saturday 12.12.2026 is the 1st Werktag before the appointment; Friday 11.12.2026 is the 2nd Werktag before the appointment. No Hessian public holiday falls in this window. Therefore the cancellation must reach the practice by Friday, 11.12.2026 at the latest to satisfy the 'at least two Werktage' notice requirement.

warnings: This is a routine appointment reminder from a dental practice with no legal remedy instructions and no payment demand; nothing suspicious was identified, but note the exact cancellation deadline depends on how 'Werktage' is interpreted (e.g., whether Saturday counts), which the letter does not clarify.
